What we do

Painting for homes and businesses

Feature walls, full repaints, decks, stairs and driveways. Each job gets the same careful prep and clean finish.

Interior Painting

Walls, ceilings, trims and doors, finished cleanly and ready to live in or sell.

Exterior Painting

Render, weatherboards, fences, stairs and decks, with finishes that suit coastal conditions.

Commercial

Apartment blocks, offices and shopfronts, scheduled to keep disruption to a minimum.

Private & Residential

Single rooms up to whole houses, inside and out, at competitive rates.
